declarations.docstring: For a displayed decomposition into finite, pairwise nonisomorphic simple complex submodules, selects a summand whose traces of all permutation operators agree with the partition attached to the given antitone index, while every other summand agrees with a different partition.

Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, a displayed decomposition into finite, pairwise nonisomorphic simple submodules has a summand whose traces of all permutation operators agree with the partition attached to the given antitone index, while every other summand agrees with a different partition.
Two simple complex submodules are linearly equivalent if the traces of every restricted permutation operator on both submodules agree with the values associated to the same partition.
The complex auxiliary value associated to an antitone natural-valued function on `Fin N` is nonzero.
Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, the auxiliary value associated to an antitone natural-valued function on `Fin N` is nonzero.
